NVIDIA reported **Q3 fiscal 2026 Gaming revenue of $4.3 billion** (approximately **$4.265 billion**), down **1% sequentially** and up **30% year over year**; the quarter ended **October 26, 2025**. [[1]] 

This is NVIDIA’s reported **Gaming and AI PC** market-platform figure—not a separately disclosed standalone **GeForce-only** revenue number. [[1]]
